title: Beginner padel socials on Monday at Play Padel Hermanus
summary: Join us every Monday for a fun filled social for beginners, at Play Padel in the Hermanus Sports Club.
description: BEGINNER SOCIALS ON MONDAY. Join us every monday for a fun filled social for beginners. Play Padel is creating an energetic, inclusive and welcoming padel culture for players of all ages and skill levels. Our home at Hermanus Sports Club: 4 Premium Courts (1 Panoramic), Clubhouse Facilities, Bossa Restaurant, Spectator Seating, Family Friendly Environment.
profile: A weekly social padel session for beginners held every Monday at Play Padel, the four-court padel club at the Hermanus Sports Club. Newcomers play friendly games and meet the club's community, with a restaurant and clubhouse on site. It suits visitors who want to try padel or play socially while in Hermanus.
